comment: dokick.c ship_object() for shop goods kicked down a hole (1696-1712): a gnomish Healer in debug mode builds minetn-7 (#wizloaddes), maps it and teleports into the candle shop's west column. She piles three candles on the middle square, wishes a hole on the west square and kicks candles west from the east square before the shopkeeper's REPAIR_DELAY elapses; the second kick's candle passes rn2(3) and falls, so stolen_value() bills the shop floor object (1699-1705) and its no_charge is cleared.
